# Default editor<AvailableFrom v="4.0.503" />

Set the default editor for opening files from Remotion Studio. Available editors: `vscode, cursor, windsurf, zed, vscodium, webstorm, sublime-text`.

## CLI flag

```text
--editor <value>
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setDefaultEditor('cursor');
```
